title: What If You Had a Mantis Shrimp's Eyes? The Twist Is Strange

scenes.text: What if you saw with a mantis shrimp's eyes? You would have four times more color channels.
Humans have three color channels. A mantis shrimp has twelve.
You might expect it to see a rainbow we cannot imagine.
But a 2014 study found it is worse than humans, bees and fish at telling similar colors apart.
It does not compare channels like we do. It seems to recognize colors almost like a barcode scanner.
More colors on the eye, but a worse picture in the brain. Fast beats fancy.
